## Rating

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple" title="Met"}
Re-running the code on the deposited data reproduces all numerical results in the paper and appendix (estimates, standard errors, test statistics, p-values, sample sizes, numbers in the text) exactly, or with differences only due to rounding or display format.

[Based on  [#99](../../sources.qmd#p99 "Introducing reproducible research standards at the world bank")/[#103](../../sources.qmd#p103 "The Challenges of Replicating Volatile Platform-Data Studies: Replicating Schatto-Eckrodt et al. (2020)")/[#109](../../sources.qmd#p109 "A protocol for structured robustness reproductions and replicability assessments"), \<1e-10 [#20](../../sources.qmd#p20 "Successes and struggles with computational reproducibility: lessons from the fragile families challenge"), within 1% [#128](../../sources.qmd#p128 "The reliability of replications: a study in computational reproductions"), \<=10% [#95](../../sources.qmd#p95 "Computational reproducibility in finance: evidence from 1,000 tests"), +/-15% & p\<=0.05 [#144](../../sources.qmd#p144 "Investigating the reproducibility of the social and behavioural sciences"), direction + significance [#107](../../sources.qmd#p107 "Teaching constructive replications in the behavioral and social sciences using quantitative data")/[#128](../../sources.qmd#p128 "The reliability of replications: a study in computational reproductions"), rounding/formatting = minor [#134](../../sources.qmd#p134 "PaperRepro: automated computational reproducibility assessment for social science papers"). CRA vs. CRR split: [#138](../../sources.qmd#p138 "Reproducibility and robustness of economics and political science research").]{.source-note}
:::
::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple" title="Partially met"}
All results are obtained, but some differ beyond rounding while the conclusions are unchanged: same direction and statistical significance, and deviations within the tolerance (e.g. \<=10% of the original value, or \<=15% and p-values differing by no more than 0.05); or only part of the results can be reproduced (e.g. main tables but not the appendix).
